_source: AS2 disassembly (tools/as2dis.py) of ExtractedAssets UI_GFx*.gfx + UnrealScript bindings; see notes/MILESTONE05_FRONTEND_MATCH_BOOTSTRAP.md sections 1.5, 2.1, 2.4, 5.7

conventions.open_submenu: parent.attachMovie(clip, inst, depth, initObj); new menu hides _global.currentMenu (ParentMenu._visible=false) and takes input via _root.inputHandler.giveInput(this)
conventions.focus: currentFocus = '<button>_mc'; buttons have focusUp/focusDown names; onOver sets HintWidget.HintText / hint_mc.HintText

screens.opened_by: UI_FrontEnd_m Kismet GFxAction_OpenMovie after Black-Out matinee
screens.logic: Game.HasWatchedIntroMovie() ? fscommand enterFrontEnd : fscommand enterMovieSequence (Kismet plays logos+FMV_intro)

screens.clip: mc_menuMain360 | mc_menuMainPS3 | mc_menuMainPC (attachMainMenu by HmUtility.Platform; registerClass HmMenu)

buttons.campaignBtn_mc: Online.CheckIsProfileReady(1) -> engine calls back _global.ProfileIsReady(1) -> attach mc_menuCampaign {Footer}
buttons.settingsBtn_mc: Online.CheckIsProfileReady(2) -> ProfileIsReady(2) -> _root.attach mc_settingsMenuLoader {hideClip: Footer, parentMenu}; hide menu, Footer alpha 0

screens.note: mc_menuOnline is only reached from the unattached variant mc_menuMain (sprite 32) - not used by the shipped attachMainMenu (HIGH)

screens.list: <TnMenuItems:GameModes> rows (FriendlyName, SettingsConfigName) in provider order TDM, DM, DOM, CTF, EXT, KOTH
for f in DataStores.GetDataStoreFields('TnGameSettings'): if GetCollectionColumnHeader('<TnGameSettings:f>',0) non-empty -> lateral selector of its rows, default = ReadValue
TDM_rows: Map Selection: Rotate|Host's Choice (Private default Host's Choice)

buttons.createGame_mc: for each row DataStores.WriteValue(field, selected FriendlyName); Online.PlayPrivateGame(SettingsConfigName)

screens.confidence: CONFIRMED flow; TDM rows HIGH (from TnOnlineGameSettingsTDM mappings with ColumnHeaderText)

screens.map_list: rows of <TnMenuItems:Maps> with IsCollectionValueEnabled && CompatibleGameTypes contains <CurrentGame:MapCompatibilityTag>; items {FriendlyName, ImagePath, MapId}; rebuilt on MapCompatibilityTag change
screens.selected_map_panel: updateSelectedMap on <CurrentGame:SelectedMapID>: mc_mapLabelMultiplayer {MapFriendlyName, colour 0xFF9333 enabled / 0xFF3333 unavailable}; map image via Self.SetExternalTextureWithPath('MapImage'+id, ImagePath) or UI_LevelThumbnails_p.LevelUnavailable

screens.views: IconicMode ? scoreboard : XP earnings first; X toggles (switchToScoreboard/switchToEarnings); B closes only when opened with a parentMenu (lobby XP screen); in-match it stays until ReturnToGameLobby travel
